title: Minemist
description: An Australian hosted server where a server entity called Misty watches you build a simulated civilization and fight in wars. Towny, War, Custom Enchants, Lore, No Mods.
body:
Take part in an evolving adventure where a server entity called Misty watches your every move. Her goal: understand humanity.
You play as a user, partaking in a simulated civilization. Join or create a town, forge a nation, and wage war over the land.

## Server Features
- Towny
- War
- Bordered world
- Server lore
- Jobs
- Culture system
- Progression ranks
- Enchantment tweaks
- Endgame progression slowed
- Custom enchantments
- MCMMO
- Chest locks
- Player warps
- Player vaults
- No mods needed
- Hosted in Sydney, Australia

Do you have what it takes to stand against the world?
